tasks.subject: Task 0: /version endpoint + GIT_COMMIT build stamp
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Identify the deployed commit/build over HTTP.

**Files:** modify app/router/crawler.py (public GET /version, APP_STARTED_AT, import socket), Dockerfile (ARG/ENV GIT_COMMIT+BUILD_DATE in final stage), docker-compose.yml:1332 (build args). Test: tests/test_crawler_version.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/router/crawler.py", "apps-microservices/crawler-service/Dockerfile", "docker-compose.yml"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_crawler_version.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["GET /version returns git_commit/build_date/replica/started_at", "defaults to unknown without env", "Dockerfile ARG->ENV"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Log ring buffer + GET /admin/recent-logs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Orchestrator log markers (AUTO_STASH etc.) queryable over HTTP via in-memory deque(5000).

**Files:** create app/core/log_buffer.py; modify main.py dictConfig (ring handler on root+uvicorn); modify app/router/admin.py (GET /admin/recent-logs?grep=&level=&limit=). Tests: tests/test_log_buffer.py, tests/test_admin_recent_logs.py, tests/test_main_ring_handler.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/core/log_buffer.py", "apps-microservices/crawler-service/main.py", "apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/router/admin.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_log_buffer.py tests/test_admin_recent_logs.py tests/test_main_ring_handler.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["records >= INFO land in ring buffer", "grep/level/limit filters", "400 on bad regex/level", "401 when API_KEY set and header missing", "handler never raises"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: GET /admin/logs/{crawl_id} crawler.log tail
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Serve tail of {storage_path}/crawler.log (default 200KB, cap 2MB, optional grep, PlainTextResponse + X-Log-Size-Bytes). Read-only, uses get_job_or_recover.

**Files:** modify app/router/admin.py. Test: tests/test_admin_crawl_log.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/router/admin.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_admin_crawl_log.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tail with partial first line dropped", "grep filter, 400 on bad regex", "404 when file absent", "no lifecycle side effects"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: GET /admin/sidecar/{crawl_id} whitelisted sidecars
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Serve the 13 known per-crawl diagnostic sidecars (callback payload, diez/QM decisions+audits, exit reason, timing-summary...). Exact-match whitelist = no traversal. JSON parsed else raw[:100k].

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/router/admin.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_admin_sidecar.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["parsed JSON under content", "raw fallback", "400 on non-whitelisted name incl. traversal", "404 when absent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: GET /admin/daemon-state + daemon heartbeats
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Liveness/backlog of the 10 shared marker dirs: file listings (cap 200), .daemon-heartbeat age, *.error/*.move-error contents (2000 chars), dead_letter. Plus heartbeat touch after 'while true; do' in tools/upload_daemon.sh:45 ($ARCHIVES_DIR) and tools/download_daemon.sh:127 ($REQUESTS_DIR).

**Files:** modify app/router/admin.py, tools/upload_daemon.sh, tools/download_daemon.sh. Test: tests/test_admin_daemon_state.py + bash -n both scripts

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/router/admin.py", "tools/upload_daemon.sh", "tools/download_daemon.sh"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_admin_daemon_state.py -v && bash -n tools/upload_daemon.sh && bash -n tools/download_daemon.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["per-dir exists/file_count/heartbeat_age/files/error_markers", "heartbeat excluded from files", "missing dirs not fatal", "daemons touch heartbeat each loop"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: ?peek=true on GET /results
tasks.description:
**Goal:** peek=true skips _record_downloaded_at (auto-stash grace clock); default unchanged. Docstring notes peek does NOT prevent inline unstash (use /admin/dataset for fully side-effect-free).

**Files:** modify app/router/crawler.py:328-352. Test: tests/test_crawler_results_peek.py + regression tests/test_auto_stash_results.py

{"files": ["apps-microservices/crawler-service/app/router/crawler.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_crawler_results_peek.py tests/test_auto_stash_results.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["peek=true -> no downloaded_at stamp", "peek=false -> unchanged", "limit documented"]}
